subject: Television & Streaming
title: Meredith Grey: The Surgeon Who Endured
description: A micro-lesson that makes Meredith Grey: The Surgeon Who Endured usable.

hook.text: Meredith Grey survived a bomb, a drowning, a plane crash, and COVID.

buildup.text: Ellen Pompeo played Meredith from intern to chief of surgery. The character aged in real time alongside the audience.

discovery.text: Grey's Anatomy became the longest-running primetime medical drama in history.

twist.text: Critics said Grey's was unrealistic. Fans didn't care.

climax.text: Meredith Grey proved that a female lead could anchor a show for 19 seasons—something few male characters have achieved.

punchline.text: Television's most resilient character outlasted everything thrown at her.

quiz.question: What record does Grey's Anatomy hold in television history?
options: First medical show on network TV
